english: With love and courage, a hundred shots, a hundred hits!
We'll take back everyone's smiles!
Phantom-Thief Angels, Twin Angel!!
Let's go! Natchan!
Roger, big sis!
Twin Phantom, here we come!
Ah! Tesla-chan, Nine-chan!!
Could you let us help too?
Yeah! Of course!!\n...Being with Tesla-chan and Nine-chan is the best!
Minazuki-san...
Really... I'm glad, Haruka-san.
Haruka... Aoi... Kurumi.
I-I never said I was fine with it!\nI mean, not that it's bad, but...
Kurumi-chan, your face is red? What's wrong?
S-shut up! It's nothing!
Now now, let's just say Kurumi-san is happy too...
Ugh, big sis...
Fufu, you're all so close.
Yeah. Like me and big sis.
So now Twin Angel is five people!
Um, there are five of us, but...\nwe're Twin Angel.
Big sis, that's not a little off, it's completely off...
Am I... an angel too...?
Ehehe, whatever — let's all keep getting along!
Yes, let's all do our best together!
'Yesterday's enemy is today's friend,' huh.\n...Hmph, don't slow us down!
Fufu, we're counting on you too!
Looking forward to it...
